doc.title: Holly Hofmann interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998

title: Playing a track of her CD
summary: Rowe plays an excerpt of one of her recordings and notes the improvised passage and her low register.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: You have pretty wide ranging tastes in music I think, by listening to your CDs. There’s still some classical elements you throw in there. And I’m not sure I have this — maybe I should just start over on this one. I wanted to play the very beginning of this one tune because I thought it was pretty neat.
Actually, Hubert Laws sounds like he listens to you.
You have a great lower register too. Now is this fairly spontaneous?
